author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets and Kirby-style character art
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists, and invests in human made work consistently!! Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs, will rotate roster of thumbnail of various artists for features!! The bulk of the work would be for channel art with fast turnaround time for his video content, and wants HUMAN MADE not AI! Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing. You will be paid fair compensation. COMMENT BELOW AND LET’S SEE WHERE IT LEADS YALL! Contact: comment on post or DM @imaginariumarts

author: malakabooksid
title: Open call for book designers and illustrators - Malaka Books
content: FOR BOOK DESIGNERS & ILLUSTRATORS 🗣️ Malaka Books bakal menerbitkan beberapa buku baru. Nah, buat kamu para illustrator dan designer, kami lagi ngebuka kesempatan kolaborasi untuk terlibat langsung dalam proses penerbitan buku cetak. Tidak ada deadline ya, silahkan mendaftar jika tertarik, akan kami cek berkala. Tertarik buat gabung? Langsung isi formulir di sini ya 👇 🔗 bit.ly/talentmalakabooks #MalakaBooks #TalentMalakaBooks Contact: bit.ly/talentmalakabooks
